name: OI-flush reversal — leverage-washout bounce (OI drop + adverse move + vol spike, 1h)
rationale: MECHANISM: a sharp open_interest contraction concurrent with a deeply negative 1h/4h return is the fingerprint of forced deleveraging — margin liquidations and ADL close positions non-economically, pushing price past fair value. vol_realized spiking confirms it is a violent cascade, not an orderly bleed. A mean-reversion taker who steps in AFTER the cascade (not during) is paid for supplying the liquidity the leveraged crowd was forced to demand; the snap-back is the mechanical rebound as liquidation flow exhausts. We buy SPOT (direction +1) and hold ~0.25-0.5d. DISCONFIRMER 1: kill if entries conditioned on the OI flush do NOT beat a same-vol-spike baseline that ignores open_interest — if so it is just buying any vol spike / falling knife, not the deleverage structure. DISCONFIRMER 2: kill if net-of-fee edge is carried by <5 mega-cascade days (Oct/Nov-2025) — a handful of tail events is unmodelable and fails effective-N/CSCV-PBO.
catalyst: open_interest drops sharply while ret is deeply negative and realized vol spikes — a forced-deleverage washout to fade long.
